observations: Photo 0: a single low-resolution photo of a bare inline four-cylinder petrol engine standing on concrete, out of a car.
Visible: intake manifold and throttle body on the left, valve cover with oil filler cap, spark plug leads, timing belt cover, crank pulley and accessory brackets.
The layout and oil cap look like a Toyota four-cylinder of the older Camry era, but no Toyota logo, engine code or serial stamp is legible.
Faint lettering on the timing cover is blurred and unreadable; a watermark crosses the lower half.
Surface is dusty with oily grime; no fluids, no running clip, no compression test, no mileage proof.
Alternator, starter and lower block are partly hidden or out of frame.

claims.evidence: Shape looks consistent with a Toyota four-cylinder, but no logo or engine code is readable in photo 0.
No engine code stamp visible in photo 0.
Origin cannot be shown by a photo; no import paperwork.
No clip of the engine running; priced as not working.
Needs a running clip with sound.
A loose engine carries no odometer.
Photo 0 is too blurred to check gasket sealant or bolt heads for tool marks.
Seller's promise; no written terms shown.

risks.risk: Engine is a different code or make from the one claimed, which sets the price
risks.proof: Sharp close-up of the engine code and serial stamped on the block

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, or has low compression
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car with sound, plus a compression gauge reading per cylinder

risks.risk: Cracked block, broken mounts or missing parts on hidden sides
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the underside, including the oil pan

risks.risk: Engine previously opened or rebuilt despite 'never opened'
risks.proof: Close-ups of head gasket line, valve cover bolts and oil pan sealant

risks.risk: Sludge or water in the oil
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and under the oil filler cap

proof_requests: Sharp close-up of the engine code and serial number stamped on the block
Clip of the engine running with sound, from cold start
Photos of all sides, the oil pan and under the oil filler cap
response.reason: The engine code that sets the price is not readable in the one blurred photo, so not even a worst case price can be retrieved. A sharp shot of the block stamp is the decisive proof; all running claims stay priced as not working.
